name: BioClinical-ModernBERT-base
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-05-07.
